notes: V30.39.2 makes the single ProbabilisticJointOptimizer runtime an atomic ESM deployment unit. The complete transitive module closure is republished and every static import in that closure carries the same build tag. The lazy-module cache now evicts rejected imports so a failed module can be retried. Diagnostics probe the optimizer closure asset-by-asset when the top-level import fails. No optimizer algorithm or gate thresholds are changed.
